about.title: About Me
about.content: Hi, I'm a software engineer, passionate about creating solutions that truly make a difference. I love projects that break the mold, ideas that challenge, and teams that dare to innovate. Naturally curious, I learn fast and enjoy turning every challenge into an opportunity to grow. For me, technology only matters if it brings people together and makes life simpler. If you're looking for someone who moves with energy, loves to think outside the box, and always keeps a smile, then we'll get along great.
about.quote: I truly believe that with passion and commitment, nothing is impossible in this field.
